Another big PR, yay. It's a single PR because there are very few meaningful pieces that can be merged independently, replacing `ParsedScope` means making all these changes.

Most of the changes should be straightforward if you've read https://tangled.org/tranquil.farm/tranquil-pds/issues/690. Everything comes from the core change of replacing `ParsedScope` with `Scope` and `ScopeSet`, and the scopes are used all over the place. There's also some code related to handling the migration of scopes in old app passwords, to match the new design.

`crates/tranquil-scopes/src/scope.rs:506` This is the kind of code I love writing (and reading). A single place that tells you exactly how scopes are parsed.

`crates/tranquil-api/src/server/app_password.rs:114` for OAuth, invalid scopes are dropped since the user can't do much about the client's request. For app passwords, we reject creation because here the user can fix their request.

Serialization now follows basic formatting rules based on ref pds, examples:

```
before  atproto repo:io.atcr.manifest repo:io.atcr.manifest?action=create&action=update&action=delete
after   atproto repo:io.atcr.manifest

before  atproto account:email?action=read
after   atproto account:email

before  atproto rpc?lxm=app.bsky.feed.getTimeline&aud=did:web:api.bsky.app%23bsky_appview
after   atproto rpc:app.bsky.feed.getTimeline?aud=did:web:api.bsky.app%23bsky_appview

before  atproto rpc:app.bsky.feed.getTimeline?aud=did:web:api.bsky.app#bsky_appview
after   atproto rpc:app.bsky.feed.getTimeline?aud=did:web:api.bsky.app%23bsky_appview
```

I don't think we can go as far to say that formatting is _stable_, there are minor differences with the ref PDS and the standard doesn't specify. We can aim to avoid changes though, and most importantly, parsing will always result in the correct result.

Also note that each dashboard endpoint now requires a specific attribute, eg `account:password?action=manage`.

I dropped `RpcCall` since it's not used anywhere.

-----

Hey, at least it removes more code than it adds 🤷‍♀️
